title: AED evaluation run record v0
description:
The evidence behind an AC5 gate decision or a bake-off measurement. A run record must answer, years later and without its author, what was measured and under what conditions: which model at which sampling parameters, against which gate, under which tokenizer, and under which reading of the iteration budget.

The load-bearing header and verdict fields are closed and required. Per-trial detail is intentionally permissive: it is diagnostic material whose shape will change as the harness grows, and freezing it would make the harness harder to improve without making any decision safer.

SCHEMA-ENFORCED SAFETY PROPERTY: `authoritative` is false unless the record was produced by a live pinned model AND a gating tokenizer, and a non-authoritative record must carry the reasons why. That makes it impossible for a replayed, scripted or stub-tokenizer run to present itself as gate evidence — which matters because the repository ships exactly such a fixture for offline testing.

record_schema_version.description: Consumers must refuse records whose version they do not know.

recorded_at.description: UTC, literal trailing Z. A run record is an observation of an external system, so unlike the netlist IR it may and must carry a timestamp.

authoritative.description: Whether this record may be cited as evidence for a gate decision. Computed by the harness from the live tokenizer, model and gate identities, never asserted by the caller. Note the limit: in a record received from elsewhere this is a self-declared field like any other, and schema validation can only catch inconsistent forgeries, not consistent ones.

non_authoritative_reasons.description: Why the record is not authoritative. Required to be non-empty whenever `authoritative` is false, so a record can never be non-authoritative for unstated reasons.

tokenizer.description: Identity of the tokenizer that produced every budget-token count in this record. The fingerprint is behavioural: two records are comparable only if their fingerprints match.

model.description: AC5 requires a pinned model with stated sampling parameters. Both are required here so a run without them cannot be recorded at all.

arms.description: One entry per measured arm. Per-trial detail below the required counters is deliberately open.

iteration_semantics.description: Which reading of AC5's '<=3 repair iterations' this arm used. Recorded because the two readings differ by roughly 33% in generosity, so numbers taken under different readings are not comparable.

a4_context_budget.description: The A4 model-facing context measured against its ceiling. The per-part breakdown is required alongside the total precisely because A4 exists to stop the teaching payload migrating from the card into the skill and out of sight.

ac5_gate.description: The AC5a threshold rule. The Wilson interval is REQUIRED alongside the verdict: a bare pass at 7/10 invites reading a threshold rule as a demonstration that the true rate exceeds the threshold, which it is not.

flip_criterion.description:
The §4 standalone-DSL flip criterion. The power fields are required so a non-significant result cannot be reported without the information needed to tell 'no difference' from 'no power to see one'.

`minimum_effect_of_interest` and `power_against_declared_effect` are required but NULLABLE. Null means no effect size was declared before the run, and in that case the verdict must be 'inconclusive' — see the constraint below. Making them required-but-nullable rather than optional forces the record to state the absence explicitly instead of leaving a reader unable to tell 'not declared' from 'not recorded'.

minimum_effect_of_interest.description: The (aed_rate, baseline_rate) difference declared worth detecting, chosen BEFORE the run. Choosing it afterwards is choosing the standard that gives the answer you already saw.

power_against_declared_effect.description: Power against the declared effect. Null when none was declared.

power_against_observed_effect.description: Informational only. Observed power is a monotone function of the p-value and adds no information beyond it, so it can never justify an adequacy claim; it is recorded because seeing it beside the declared figure is what makes an underpowered run obvious.

verdict.description: Three-valued on purpose. 'inconclusive' means the run lacked the power to answer, which is a real outcome and must not be collapsed into 'not met'.

then.$comment: Without a pre-declared effect size there is no basis for calling a run adequately powered, so 'flip_criterion_not_met' is unrecordable. A significant result stands on its own and remains recordable.
A record that disclaims authority must say why. Silence would leave a reader unable to tell a deliberate fixture from a broken run.

A stub tokenizer is non-gating by construction. Without this, `gating` was just a boolean a forger could flip: review demonstrated a hand-edited record with kind=stub, gating=true and authoritative=true validating with zero errors. Tying gating to kind removes the free variable.

An authoritative record cannot rest on a non-gating tokenizer, a replayed/scripted/stub model, or a replayed gate. WHAT THIS CANNOT DO, stated plainly rather than overclaimed: every one of these fields is SELF-DECLARED, so a forger who relabels all of them consistently produces a record no schema can distinguish from a real one. Schema validation catches the careless forgery and the honest mistake, which is what it is for; making a record tamper-EVIDENT needs a signature over the identities, which v0 does not have. The harness itself computes `authoritative` from the live identities and cannot be talked out of it, so records this project produces are trustworthy by construction; records submitted by a third party are trustworthy only to the extent you trust the submitter.

A budget block claiming to have passed must show non-negative headroom. The block was previously stored verbatim from the caller and never checked, so a record could assert that a 64K-token context passed a 12K limit and validate cleanly - the exact exploit the A4 fix was written to close.

AC5a is gated on the model seeing ONLY the <=12K A4 context, so an authoritative record must carry the measurement. Omitting it was the other half of the same exploit: no measurement, nothing to contradict.
